_about: SU (the NCHC compute point) rates for estimate_su. 'factor' = SU per core-hour of one queue. Taiwania 3 general (NRQ) rate: fixed price per core-hour, no per-queue multiplier, so every listed T3 queue is 1. ct2k-amd's price was not found, so it stays null (unknown). The nchc site (the ngs queues of nchc.config) has no price list here and stays null. Do not guess a number here.
source_quote: NRQ採固定費率計價…非學研界使用費率…為上述對應各費率之2倍. 國科會計畫 and 學術計畫 0.08 元/核心小時; 政府法人 and 企業個人 0.16 元/核心小時
assumption: 1 SU = 1 core-hour is inferred (both lists price NSTC at 0.08); not stated by NCHC; verify with get_su_balance before/after a run
not_used: https://lions.nchc.org.tw/ngs.jsp (GP1 genomics core-facility list, academic 0.24 TWD per SU): not used because the maintainer is unsure which list applies and the Taiwania 3 general (NRQ) rate is used instead
